name: int_repr
description: ATen schema: aten::int_repr(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Returns the raw integer codes of an affine-quantized tensor as a fresh plain integer tensor on the input device (quint8 to uint8, qint8 to int8, qint32 to int32). The output shape matches the input, and the output does not alias the quantized storage. The int_repr_out Definition covers the independent out overload.
